item.title: Dense Fog Causes Multi-Vehicle Crash in Pattoki, Motorway Police Issue Safety Cautions
item.description: A dense fog blanketed the roads near Pattoki, leading to a multi-vehicle collision early Monday morning. The reduced visibility led to several vehicles crashing into one another. Motorway Police swiftly responded to the scene, helping rescue teams rush the injured to nearby hospitals. item.title: Huawei Powers China’s First Level 3 Self-Driving Cars
item.description: China's MIIT approved the BAIC Arcfox Alpha S and Changan Deepal SL03, both featuring Huawei's Qiankun ADS system, as the country's first Level 3 (L3) autonomous pilot vehicles for public road commercial deployment.
